title: No one to play with because of the toxic community
body: This game is extremely fun, at least back when it first came out, now it’s full of toxic players who won’t play a SINGLE match due to a new player being in the lobby. This is what happened: I opened the game and clicked the “Novice” channel. I played the tutorial and tried to join a match. Unfortunately all games were in a foreign language or they were in a lobby to “talk” (From my understanding there are three lobby types. 1 for classic, 1 for dueling, and 1 for chatting). Now I haven’t played since the “Judge” class was announced and with prior experience and no lobbies to join I swapped channels. I joined an English game with one other player who looked to be in the same situation as me. We had two more players joined who were in the two THOUSANDS of a win/loss ratio. They were trying to kick us out of the lobby so they could use it. They kept on saying that we should go to the “Novice” channel to level up but after explaining why I wasn’t going to do that they just got mad and were holding the room hostage (a bit extreme use of words I know). After arguing with these two players the host left and I became the room master. The original host joined back immediately so I started a game. I got lucky and got the “Mafia” class. I killed one of the toxic players and the other was a cop (ghoul). He tried his best to convince that I was the Mafia but I swayed the doctor’s vote since there was no way he could’ve know I was the Mafia until Night 2. I ended up winning I just proved to them that I can still play the game just as well or even better than them. They were mad but I don’t care, lol. It just makes me upset that new players can’t enjoy this amazing game due to language barriers or the toxic community. I tried my best to get back into this game but after an entire week with only being able to play TWO games! It just isn’t worth it.
